footer.default: Automated transactional email, please do not reply.
footer.tagline: — your storefront, your orders, your revenue.

buyerConfirmation.subject: Your order at {shopName} is confirmed
buyerConfirmation.title: Order confirmed
buyerConfirmation.body: Your order #{orderId} at {shopName} has been successfully recorded. The seller will process it and reach out if needed.
buyerConfirmation.paymentNote: Payment is made directly with the seller.

sellerNewOrder.subject: New order — {firstName} · {total}
sellerNewOrder.title: New order
sellerNewOrder.footerReply: Reply to this email to contact your customer directly.

buyerAccepted.subject: Order accepted ✓ — {shopName}
buyerAccepted.title: Order accepted
buyerAccepted.body: Good news: your order #{orderId} at {shopName} has been accepted and is being prepared.
buyerAccepted.note: The seller will get in touch if there's anything else you need.

buyerReady.subject: Your order is ready ✓ — {shopName}
buyerReady.title: Order ready
buyerReady.body: Your order #{orderId} at {shopName} is ready! You can come pick it up.
buyerReady.note: The seller will let you know the pickup details if needed.

buyerCancelled.subject: Order cancelled — {shopName}
buyerCancelled.title: Order cancelled
buyerCancelled.body: Your order #{orderId} at {shopName} has been cancelled.
buyerCancelled.note: For any questions, please contact the seller directly.

passwordChanged.subject: Your FLUX password has been changed
passwordChanged.title: Password changed
passwordChanged.preheader: Security confirmation — your password has changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your FLUX account has just been changed. If you made this change, no action is needed.
passwordChanged.note: Don't recognize this action? Reset your password immediately and check the security of your inbox.

friendInvite.subject: {fromName} invites you to try FLUX
friendInvite.title: Take back control of your business
friendInvite.preheader: {fromName} thinks FLUX could save you precious time
friendInvite.pitch: FLUX brings your online storefront, orders, appointments, and content together in one place. No more juggling dozens of scattered tools: one single login, your whole business right in front of you.
friendInvite.gain1: Hours saved every week on admin work
friendInvite.gain2: A pro online storefront set up in minutes
friendInvite.gain3: Orders and revenue tracked at a glance
friendInvite.footer: You're receiving this email because a FLUX user invited you. No action is required if you're not interested.

verification.subject: Verify your email — FLUX
verification.title: Verify your email
verification.body: Your FLUX workspace is ready and you can already start using it. Just confirm this email address is yours to unlock publishing your storefront and payments.
verification.note: If you didn't sign up for this, simply ignore this email.

hints.spamSelf: If you don't see it, check your spam folder.
hints.spamOther: The email might land in spam: give them a heads-up.
